waveletl1.variables module

class waveletl1.variables.VariablesGenerator(cosmo, variance, zs, theta1, nz_file, nplanes, chis, dchis, z_array, lensing_weight)[source]

Bases: object

Stores configuration and calculates the final map variance (sigmasq_map). Relies on injected cosmology, variance, and pre-calculated plane information.

Injected cosmology object.

Type:

Cosmology_function

variance

Injected variance object.

Type:

float

Type:

float

nz_file

np.ndarray

Type:

np.ndarray

Redshifts corresponding to chis.
